# Smash Cut with Shake

**Cut › Smash Cut** · v1.0.0 · 16 frames at 30 fps (8–30)

A hard cut to the next scene, which lands with a short, decaying camera shake.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/smash-cut-shake@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Comedic or dramatic contrast
- Beat drops
- Impacts

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import smashCutShake from './transitions/01-cut/smash-cut/smash-cut-shake';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(smashCutShake, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 16 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cutAt` | number | `0.25` | 0–0.9 | Where in the transition the cut happens (0..1). |
| `strength` | number | `28` | 0–80 | Shake distance in pixels. |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
